translations.literal: Moreover at seasonal offerings in the ancestral temple, officials act by proxy; the prayer text says: 'Filial great-grandson the emperor, your servant so-and-so, respectfully sends Grand Marshal so-and-so, daring to announce to Gaozu the Divine Martial Emperor and ancestral consort Empress Taimu of the Dou clan.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover at seasonal offerings in the ancestral temple, officials act by proxy. The prayer text says, "Filial great-grandson the emperor, your servant so-and-so, respectfully sends Grand Marshal so-and-so, daring to announce to Gaozu the Divine Martial Emperor and ancestral consort Empress Taimu of the Dou clan.

sentences.zh: 時惟孟春，永懷罔極。

translations.literal: The season is early spring; forever cherishing boundless longing.
translations.idiomatic: The season is early spring; forever cherishing boundless longing.

sentences.zh: 謹以一元大武、柔毛剛鬣、明粢薌萁、嘉蔬嘉薦醴齊，敬脩時享，以申追慕。」

translations.literal: Respectfully with one great martial victim, soft fur and hard bristles, bright grain and fragrant millet, fine vegetables and fine offerings, sacrificial ale, respectfully performing the seasonal offering to express pursuing remembrance.'
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully with one great martial victim, soft fur and hard bristles, bright grain and fragrant millet, fine vegetables and fine offerings, sacrificial ale, respectfully performing the seasonal offering to express pursuing remembrance."

sentences.zh: 此祝辭也。

translations.literal: This is the prayer wording.
translations.idiomatic: This is the prayer wording.

sentences.zh: 前享七日質明，太尉誓百官於尚書省曰：「某月某日時享於太廟，各揚其職。

translations.literal: Seven days before the offering at dawn, the Grand Marshal swore the hundred officials at the Ministry of Civil Service, saying: 'On such month such day the seasonal offering at the ancestral temple—each display his duty.
translations.idiomatic: Seven days before the offering at dawn, the Grand Marshal swore the hundred officials at the Ministry of Civil Service, saying, "On such month such day the seasonal offering at the ancestral temple—each display his duty.

sentences.zh: 不供其事，國有常刑。」

translations.literal: Not supplying his affair—the state has constant punishment.'
translations.idiomatic: Not supplying his affair—the state has constant punishment."

sentences.zh: 凡陪享之官，散齋四日，致齋三日，然後可以為祭也。

translations.literal: In all, accompanying officials fasted in dispersal four days, reached fasting three days, and then could perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In all, accompanying officials fasted in dispersal four days, reached fasting three days, and then could perform sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 宗廟之禮，非敢擅議，雖有知者，其誰敢言？

translations.literal: Ancestral temple ritual—not daring to discuss rashly; though there were those who knew, who dared speak?
translations.idiomatic: Ancestral temple ritual—not daring to discuss rashly; though there were those who knew, who dared speak?

sentences.zh: 故六十餘年行之不廢。

translations.literal: Therefore for sixty-plus years it was practiced without abolition.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore for sixty-plus years it was practiced without abolition.

sentences.zh: 今聖朝以弓矢既橐，禮樂為大，故下百僚，可得詳議。

translations.literal: Now the sage court, since bows and arrows are sheathed and ritual and music are great, therefore sent down the hundred officials; detailed discussion may be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Now the sage court, since bows and arrows are sheathed and ritual and music are great, therefore sent down the hundred officials for detailed discussion.

sentences.zh: 臣等以為《貞觀》、《開元禮》並無太廟上食之文，以禮斷情，罷之可也。

translations.literal: We your servants think the Zhenguan and Kaiyuan Rites both lack text on ancestral temple food presentation; cutting feeling by ritual, abolishing it is possible.
translations.idiomatic: We your servants think the Zhenguan and Kaiyuan Rites both lack text on ancestral temple food presentation. Cutting feeling by ritual, abolishing it is possible.

sentences.zh: 至若陵寢上食，采《國語》、《禮記》日祭、月祭之詞，因秦、漢之制，修而存之，以廣孝道可也。

translations.literal: As for tomb food presentation, adopting the Guoyu and Liji words on daily and monthly sacrifice, following Qin and Han institutions, repairing and preserving to broaden filial way is possible.
translations.idiomatic: As for tomb food presentation, adopting the Guoyu and Liji words on daily and monthly sacrifice, following Qin and Han institutions, repairing and preserving to broaden filial way is possible.

sentences.zh: 如此，則經義可據，故事不遺。

translations.literal: Like this, then classic meaning may be relied on and old precedents not lost.
translations.idiomatic: Like this, then classic meaning may be relied on and old precedents not lost.

sentences.zh: 大禮既明，永息異論，可以繼二帝三王，而為萬代法。

translations.literal: Great ritual being clear, forever ending divergent discussion, can continue the two emperors and three kings and become law for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Great ritual being clear, forever ending divergent discussion, can continue the two emperors and three kings and become law for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 與其瀆禮越古，貴因循而憚改作，猶天地之相遠也。

translations.literal: Compared with violating ritual and surpassing antiquity, valuing following precedent and fearing reform—like Heaven and Earth far apart.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with violating ritual and surpassing antiquity, valuing following precedent and fearing reform—it is like Heaven and Earth far apart.

sentences.zh: 知禮者是之，事竟不行。

translations.literal: Those who knew ritual approved; the affair in the end was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Those who knew ritual approved; the affair in the end was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 翺性剛急，論議無所避。

translations.literal: Ao's nature was firm and hasty; in discussion he avoided nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Ao's nature was firm and hasty; in discussion he avoided nothing.

sentences.zh: 執政雖重其學，而惡其激訐，故久次不遷。

translations.literal: Those in power though valued his learning hated his sharp attacks; therefore long without promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Those in power though valued his learning hated his sharp attacks; therefore he long went without promotion.

sentences.zh: 翺以史官記事不實，奏狀曰：「臣謬得秉筆史館，以記註為職。

translations.literal: Ao, because historiographers' recording of affairs was not true, submitted a memorial, saying: 'Your servant wrongly obtained holding the brush in the Historiography Institute, taking annotation as duty.
translations.idiomatic: Ao, because historiographers' recording of affairs was not true, submitted a memorial, saying, "Your servant wrongly obtained holding the brush in the Historiography Institute, taking annotation as duty.

sentences.zh: 夫勸善懲惡，正言直筆，紀聖朝功德，述忠賢事業，載奸臣醜行，以傳無窮者，史官之任也。

translations.literal: Encouraging good and punishing evil, upright words and straight brush, recording the sage court's merit and virtue, narrating loyal and worthy careers, carrying treacherous ministers' ugly conduct to transmit without end—that is the historiographer's charge.
translations.idiomatic: Encouraging good and punishing evil, upright words and straight brush, recording the sage court's merit and virtue, narrating loyal and worthy careers, carrying treacherous ministers' ugly conduct to transmit without end—that is the historiographer's charge.

sentences.zh: 凡人事跡，非大善大惡，則眾人無由得知，舊例皆訪於人，又取行狀謚議，以為依據。

translations.literal: In all human affairs and traces, if not great good or great evil, then the multitude have no way to know; old precedent all inquired of people, again taking conduct summaries and posthumous discussions as reliance.
translations.idiomatic: In all human affairs and traces, if not great good or great evil, then the multitude have no way to know. Old precedent all inquired of people, again taking conduct summaries and posthumous discussions as reliance.

sentences.zh: 今之作行狀者，多是其門生故吏，莫不虛加仁義禮智，妄言忠肅惠和。

translations.literal: Now those composing conduct summaries are mostly their students and former subordinates; none fail to falsely add benevolence, righteousness, propriety, and wisdom, rashly speaking loyalty, reverence, kindness, and harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Now those composing conduct summaries are mostly their students and former subordinates. None fail to falsely add benevolence, righteousness, propriety, and wisdom, rashly speaking loyalty, reverence, kindness, and harmony.

sentences.zh: 此不唯其處心不實，茍欲虛美於受恩之地耳。

translations.literal: This is not only that their hearts are not true; they merely wish to falsely beautify the place of received favor.
translations.idiomatic: This is not only that their hearts are not true; they merely wish to falsely beautify the place of received favor.

sentences.zh: 蓋為文者，又非遊、夏、遷、雄之列，務於華而忘其實，溺於文而棄其理。

translations.literal: Those who compose literature again are not in the ranks of You, Xia, Qian, and Xiong; they strive for ornament and forget reality, drowning in literature and abandoning principle.
translations.idiomatic: Those who compose literature again are not in the ranks of You, Xia, Qian, and Xiong. They strive for ornament and forget reality, drowning in literature and abandoning principle.

sentences.zh: 故為文則失《六經》之古風，紀事則非史遷之實錄。

translations.literal: Therefore composing literature then loses the Six Classics' ancient wind; recording affairs then is not the Grand Historian's veritable record.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore composing literature then loses the Six Classics' ancient wind; recording affairs then is not the Grand Historian's veritable record.

sentences.zh: 臣今請作行狀者，但指事實，直載事功。

translations.literal: Your servant now requests that those composing conduct summaries only point to facts and directly carry affairs and merit.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant now requests that those composing conduct summaries only point to facts and directly carry affairs and merit.

sentences.zh: 假如作《魏徵傳》，但記其諫諍之辭，足以為正直；

translations.literal: Suppose composing the biography of Wei Zheng—only record his remonstrating words, sufficient to be upright;
translations.idiomatic: Suppose composing the biography of Wei Zheng—only record his remonstrating words, sufficient to be upright;

sentences.zh: 段秀實但記其倒用司農印以追逆兵，以象笏擊朱泚，足以為忠烈。

translations.literal: Duan Xiushi only record his reversing use of the Court of Imperial Granaries seal to pursue rebel troops, striking Zhu Ci with the ivory tablet—sufficient to be loyal and fierce.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Xiushi only record his reversing use of the Court of Imperial Granaries seal to pursue rebel troops, striking Zhu Ci with the ivory tablet—sufficient to be loyal and fierce.

sentences.zh: 若考功視行狀，不依此者不得受。

translations.literal: If the Ministry of Personnel views conduct summaries and does not follow this, it may not receive them.
translations.idiomatic: If the Ministry of Personnel views conduct summaries and does not follow this, it may not receive them.

sentences.zh: 依此，則考功下太常，牒史館，然後定謚。

translations.literal: Following this, then the Ministry of Personnel sends down to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, notifies the Historiography Institute, and then fixes the posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: Following this, then the Ministry of Personnel sends down to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, notifies the Historiography Institute, and then fixes the posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 伏乞以臣此奏下考功。」

translations.literal: I humbly beg that your servant's this memorial be sent down to the Ministry of Personnel.'
translations.idiomatic: I humbly beg that your servant's this memorial be sent down to the Ministry of Personnel."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: It was followed.

sentences.zh: 尋權知職方員外郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was temporarily in charge as Vice Director of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was temporarily in charge as Vice Director of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 十五年六月，授考功員外郎，並兼史職。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifteenth year he was appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, concurrently holding historiography duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifteenth year he was appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, concurrently holding historiography duties.

sentences.zh: 翺與李景儉友善。

translations.literal: Ao was friendly with Li Jingjian.
translations.idiomatic: Ao was friendly with Li Jingjian.

sentences.zh: 初，景儉拜諫議大夫，舉翺自代。

translations.literal: At first when Jingjian was appointed Remonstrance Official, he recommended Ao to replace himself.
translations.idiomatic: At first when Jingjian was appointed Remonstrance Official, he recommended Ao to replace himself.

sentences.zh: 至是，景儉貶黜，七月，出翺為朗州刺史。

translations.literal: At this time Jingjian was demoted and dismissed; in the seventh month Ao was sent out as prefect of Langzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Jingjian was demoted and dismissed. In the seventh month Ao was sent out as prefect of Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 俄而景儉復為諫議大夫，翺亦入為禮部郎中。

translations.literal: Soon Jingjian again became Remonstrance Official; Ao also entered as Director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jingjian again became Remonstrance Official. Ao also entered as Director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 翺自負辭藝，以為合知制誥，以久未如誌，郁郁不樂。

translations.literal: Ao relied on his own literary talent, thinking he ought to know edict drafting; because long not as wished, he was gloomy and unhappy.
translations.idiomatic: Ao relied on his own literary talent, thinking he ought to know edict drafting. Because long not as wished, he was gloomy and unhappy.

sentences.zh: 因入中書謁宰相，面數李逢吉之過失。

translations.literal: Therefore entering the Secretariat to visit the chancellor, face to face he counted Li Fengji's faults.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore entering the Secretariat to visit the chancellor, face to face he counted Li Fengji's faults.

sentences.zh: 逢吉不之校。

translations.literal: Fengji did not contend with him.
translations.idiomatic: Fengji did not contend with him.

sentences.zh: 翺心不自安，乃請告。

translations.literal: Ao's heart was not at ease; he then requested leave.
translations.idiomatic: Ao's heart was not at ease; he then requested leave.

sentences.zh: 滿百日，有司準例停官，逢吉奏授廬州刺史。

translations.literal: When a full hundred days were complete, the relevant office by precedent stopped office; Fengji memorialized appointing him prefect of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When a full hundred days were complete, the relevant office by precedent stopped office. Fengji memorialized appointing him prefect of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 太和初，入朝為諫議大夫，尋以本官知制誥。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taihe he entered court as Remonstrance Official; soon with his original office he knew edict drafting.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taihe he entered court as Remonstrance Official; soon with his original office he knew edict drafting.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year he was appointed Attendant in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year he was appointed Attendant in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 初，諫議大夫柏耆將使滄州軍前宣諭，翺嘗贊成此行。

translations.literal: At first Remonstrance Official Bo Qi was about to be envoy to proclaim before the Cangzhou army; Ao once endorsed this journey.
translations.idiomatic: At first Remonstrance Official Bo Qi was about to be envoy to proclaim before the Cangzhou army. Ao once endorsed this journey.

sentences.zh: 柏耆尋以擅入滄州得罪，翺坐謬舉，左授少府少監。

translations.literal: Bo Qi soon for trespassing entering Cangzhou was punished; Ao sat for mistaken recommendation and was demoted left to Vice Director of the Palace Works.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Qi soon for trespassing entering Cangzhou was punished. Ao sat for mistaken recommendation and was demoted left to Vice Director of the Palace Works.

sentences.zh: 俄出為鄭州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was sent out as prefect of Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was sent out as prefect of Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 五年，出為桂州刺史、御史中丞，充桂管都防禦使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was sent out as prefect of Guizhou and Vice Censor-in-Chief, filling Guiguan all-defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was sent out as prefect of Guizhou and Vice Censor-in-Chief, filling Guiguan all-defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七年，改授潭州刺史、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was changed and appointed prefect of Tanzhou and Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was changed and appointed prefect of Tanzhou and Hunan observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八年，徵為刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was summoned as Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was summoned as Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 九年，轉戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 七月，檢校戶部尚書、襄州刺史，充山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was made acting Minister of Revenue and prefect of Xiangzhou, filling Shannan East Circuit military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was made acting Minister of Revenue and prefect of Xiangzhou, filling Shannan East Circuit military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，卒於鎮，謚曰文。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era he died at his command; posthumous title Wen.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era he died at his command. His posthumous title was Wen.

sentences.zh: 宇文籍，字夏龜。

translations.literal: Yu Wenji, styled Xiagui.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Wenji, whose courtesy name was Xiagui.

sentences.zh: 父滔，官卑。

translations.literal: His father Tao held low office.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tao held low office.

sentences.zh: 少好學，尤通《春秋》。

translations.literal: In youth he loved learning and especially mastered the Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he loved learning and especially mastered the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 竇群自處士徵為右拾遺，表籍自代，由是知名。

translations.literal: Dou Qun from retired gentleman was summoned as Right Reminder; he memorialized Ji to replace himself; by this he became known.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Qun, from retired gentleman, was summoned as Right Reminder. He memorialized Ji to replace himself. By this he became known.

sentences.zh: 登進士第。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi degree.

sentences.zh: 宰相武元衡出鎮西蜀，奏為從事。

translations.literal: Chancellor Wu Yuanheng went out to command western Shu; he memorialized him as staff member.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Wu Yuanheng went out to command western Shu and memorialized him as staff member.

sentences.zh: 以咸陽尉直史館，與韓愈同修《順宗實錄》，遷監察御史。

translations.literal: As Xianyang magistrate he served directly in the Historiography Institute; with Han Yu he jointly revised the Veritable Record of Emperor Shunzong; he was promoted to Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: As Xianyang magistrate he served directly in the Historiography Institute. With Han Yu he jointly revised the Veritable Record of Emperor Shunzong and was promoted to Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 王承宗叛，詔捕其弟駙馬都尉承系，其賓客中有為誤識者。

translations.literal: Wang Chengzong rebelled; an edict arrested his younger brother, Imperial Son-in-Law Chengsi; among his guests there was one mistakenly identified.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengzong rebelled. An edict arrested his younger brother, Imperial Son-in-Law Chengsi. Among his guests there was one mistakenly identified.

sentences.zh: 又蘇表以破淮西策幹宰相武元衡，元衡不用。

translations.literal: Again Su Biao with strategy to break Huaixi approached Chancellor Wu Yuanheng; Yuanheng did not use it.
translations.idiomatic: Again Su Biao with strategy to break Huaixi approached Chancellor Wu Yuanheng. Yuanheng did not use it.

sentences.zh: 以籍舊從事，令召表訊之，籍因與表狎。

translations.literal: Because Ji was formerly staff member, he ordered summoning Biao to interrogate; Ji therefore became intimate with Biao.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ji was formerly staff member, he ordered summoning Biao to interrogate. Ji therefore became intimate with Biao.

sentences.zh: 元衡怒，坐貶江陵府戶曹參軍。

translations.literal: Yuanheng was angry; he sat and was demoted to revenue aide of Jiangling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanheng was angry. He sat and was demoted to revenue aide of Jiangling Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至任，節度使孫簡知重之，欲令兼幕府職事。

translations.literal: Arriving at post, military commissioner Sun Jian knew and valued him, wishing to make him concurrently hold secretariat staff duties.
translations.idiomatic: Arriving at post, military commissioner Sun Jian knew and valued him, wishing to make him concurrently hold secretariat staff duties.

sentences.zh: 籍辭曰：「籍以君命譴黜，亦當以君命升。

translations.literal: Ji declined, saying: 'Ji by the ruler's command was censured and demoted; he also ought to rise by the ruler's command.
translations.idiomatic: Ji declined, saying, "Ji by the ruler's command was censured and demoted; he also ought to rise by the ruler's command.

sentences.zh: 假榮偷獎，非所願也。」

translations.literal: Borrowing glory and stealing reward is not what is wished.'
translations.idiomatic: Borrowing glory and stealing reward is not what is wished."

sentences.zh: 後考滿，連辟籓府，入為侍御史，轉著作郎，遷駕部員外郎、史館修撰。

translations.literal: Later when evaluation term was complete, repeatedly recruited to prefectural staffs, he entered as Attending Censor, transferred to Compiler, promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Imperial Studs and Compiler in the Historiography Institute.
translations.idiomatic: Later when evaluation term was complete, repeatedly recruited to prefectural staffs, he entered as Attending Censor, transferred to Compiler, and was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Imperial Studs and Compiler in the Historiography Institute.

sentences.zh: 與韋處厚、韋表微、路隨、沈傳師同修《憲宗實錄》。

translations.literal: With Wei Chuhou, Wei Biaowei, Lu Sui, and Shen Chuanshi he jointly revised the Veritable Record of Emperor Xianzong.
translations.idiomatic: With Wei Chuhou, Wei Biaowei, Lu Sui, and Shen Chuanshi he jointly revised the Veritable Record of Emperor Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 俄以本官知制誥，轉庫部郎中。

translations.literal: Soon with his original office he knew edict drafting; he was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Soon with his original office he knew edict drafting. He was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Treasury.

sentences.zh: 太和中，遷諫議大夫，專掌史筆，罷知制誥。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he was promoted to Remonstrance Official, exclusively holding the historian's brush; he ceased knowing edict drafting.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he was promoted to Remonstrance Official, exclusively holding the historian's brush. He ceased knowing edict drafting.

sentences.zh: 籍性簡淡寡合，耽玩經史，精於著述，而風望峻整，為時輩推重。

translations.literal: Ji's nature was simple, bland, and hard to join; he immersed in classics and histories, refined in writing, yet his reputation was stern and orderly; contemporaries pushed and valued him.
translations.idiomatic: Ji's nature was simple, bland, and hard to join. He immersed himself in classics and histories and was refined in writing, yet his reputation was stern and orderly. Contemporaries pushed and valued him.

sentences.zh: 正月卒，時年五十九，贈工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first month he died, aged fifty-nine; posthumously made Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month he died, aged fifty-nine. He was posthumously made Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 子監，大中初登進士第。

translations.literal: His son Jian at the beginning of Dazhong passed the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jian at the beginning of Dazhong passed the jinshi degree.

sentences.zh: 劉禹錫，字夢得，彭城人。

translations.literal: Liu Yuxi, styled Mengde, was a native of Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuxi, whose courtesy name was Mengde, was a native of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 祖云。

translations.literal: Grandfather Yun.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Yun.

sentences.zh: 父漵，仕歷州縣令佐，世以儒學稱。

translations.literal: Father Su served through prefectural and county magistracies and aides; the family for generations was famed in Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: His father Su served through prefectural and county magistracies and aides. The family for generations was famed in Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 禹錫擢進士第，又登宏辭科。

translations.literal: Yuxi passed the jinshi degree and again passed the macro-elocution examination.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxi passed the jinshi degree and again passed the macro-elocution examination.

sentences.zh: 禹錫精於古文，善五言詩，今體文章復多才麗。

translations.literal: Yuxi was refined in ancient writing and good at five-character poetry; modern-style literature again was much talented and ornate.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxi was refined in ancient writing and good at five-character poetry. His modern-style literature again was much talented and ornate.

sentences.zh: 從事淮南節度使杜佑幕，典記室，尤加禮異。

translations.literal: Serving in Huainan military commissioner Du You's staff as record office manager, he was especially treated with ritual distinction.
translations.idiomatic: Serving in Huainan military commissioner Du You's staff as record office manager, he was especially treated with ritual distinction.

sentences.zh: 從佑入朝，為監察御史。

translations.literal: Following You into court, he became Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Following You into court, he became Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 與吏部郎中韋執誼相善。

translations.literal: He was friendly with Ministry of Personnel Director Wei Zhiyi.
translations.idiomatic: He was friendly with Ministry of Personnel Director Wei Zhiyi.

sentences.zh: 貞元末，王叔文於東宮用事，後輩務進，多附麗之。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhenyuan Wang Shuwen handled affairs at the Eastern Palace; later comers striving for advancement mostly attached to him.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhenyuan Wang Shuwen handled affairs at the Eastern Palace. Later comers striving for advancement mostly attached to him.

sentences.zh: 禹錫尤為叔文知獎，以宰相器待之。

translations.literal: Yuxi was especially known and rewarded by Shuwen; he was treated with the vessel of chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxi was especially known and rewarded by Shuwen. He was treated with the vessel of chancellor.

sentences.zh: 順宗即位，久疾不任政事，禁中文誥，皆出於叔文。

translations.literal: When Shunzong ascended, long ill and unable to bear government; forbidden precinct documents and edicts all issued from Shuwen.
translations.idiomatic: When Shunzong ascended, long ill and unable to bear government. Forbidden precinct documents and edicts all issued from Shuwen.

sentences.zh: 引禹錫及柳宗元入禁中，與之圖議，言無不從。

translations.literal: He led Yuxi and Liu Zongyuan into the forbidden precinct; with them plotted and discussed; in words none failed to follow.
translations.idiomatic: He led Yuxi and Liu Zongyuan into the forbidden precinct and with them plotted and discussed. In words none failed to follow.

sentences.zh: 轉屯田員外郎、判度支鹽鐵案，兼崇陵使判官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Directorate of Agriculture and judged the salt and iron case of the Finance Commission, concurrently Chongling envoy aide.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Directorate of Agriculture and judged the salt and iron case of the Finance Commission, concurrently Chongling envoy aide.

sentences.zh: 頗怙威權，中傷端士。

translations.literal: Quite relying on power and authority, he wounded upright gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: Quite relying on power and authority, he wounded upright gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 宗元素不悅武元衡，時武元衡為御史中丞，乃左授右庶子。

translations.literal: Zongyuan originally was not pleased with Wu Yuanheng; at that time Wu Yuanheng was Vice Censor-in-Chief; he was demoted left to Right Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyuan originally was not pleased with Wu Yuanheng. At that time Wu Yuanheng was Vice Censor-in-Chief. He was demoted left to Right Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household.

sentences.zh: 侍御史竇群奏禹錫挾邪亂政，不宜在朝。

translations.literal: Attending Censor Dou Qun memorialized that Yuxi harbored perversity and disturbed government, not fitting to be in court.
translations.idiomatic: Attending Censor Dou Qun memorialized that Yuxi harbored perversity and disturbed government, not fitting to be in court.

sentences.zh: 群即日罷官。

translations.literal: Qun that day was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Qun that day was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 韓臯憑藉貴門，不附叔文黨，出為湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: Han Gao relied on noble gate, not attaching to Shuwen's faction; he was sent out as Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Han Gao relied on noble gate, not attaching to Shuwen's faction. He was sent out as Hunan observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 既任喜怒淩人，京師人士不敢指名，道路以目，時號「二王、劉、柳。」

translations.literal: Once in office, indulging joy and anger to bully people, capital scholars dared not point by name; on the road they looked with eyes; the age called them 'the Two Wangs, Liu, and Liu.'
translations.idiomatic: Once in office, indulging joy and anger to bully people, capital scholars dared not speak their names aloud. People only exchanged glances in the streets. The age called them "the Two Wangs, Liu, and Liu."

sentences.zh: 叔文敗，坐貶連州刺史。

translations.literal: When Shuwen failed, he sat and was demoted to prefect of Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Shuwen failed, he sat and was demoted to prefect of Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 在道，貶朗州司馬。

translations.literal: On the road he was demoted to Langzhou adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: On the road he was demoted to Langzhou adjutant.

sentences.zh: 地居西南夷，士風僻陋，舉目殊俗，無可與言者。

translations.literal: The land lay in southwestern barbarians; local custom was rustic and crude; looking up one saw strange customs; none with whom to speak.
translations.idiomatic: The land lay in southwestern barbarians. Local custom was rustic and crude. Looking up one saw strange customs; there was none with whom to speak.

sentences.zh: 禹錫在朗州十年，唯以文章吟詠，陶冶情性。

translations.literal: Yuxi at Langzhou ten years, only with literature chanting and singing, cultivating disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxi at Langzhou ten years, only with literature chanting and singing cultivated disposition.

sentences.zh: 蠻俗好巫，每淫祠鼓舞，必歌俚辭。

translations.literal: Barbarian custom loved shamans; whenever excessive shrines drummed and danced, they must sing rustic lyrics.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarian custom loved shamans. Whenever excessive shrines drummed and danced, they must sing rustic lyrics.

sentences.zh: 禹錫或從事於其間，乃依騷人之作，為新辭以教巫祝。

translations.literal: Yuxi sometimes joined in their midst; then following the Sao poets' compositions, he made new lyrics to teach shamans and invokers.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxi sometimes joined in their midst. Then following the Sao poets' compositions, he made new lyrics to teach shamans and invokers.

sentences.zh: 故武陵溪洞間夷歌，率多禹錫之辭也。

translations.literal: Therefore among Wuling streams and caves barbarian songs mostly were Yuxi's words.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore among Wuling streams and caves barbarian songs mostly were Yuxi's words.

sentences.zh: 初，禹錫、宗元等八人犯眾怒，憲宗亦怒，故再貶。

translations.literal: At first Yuxi, Zongyuan, and the other eight offended the multitude's anger; Xianzong also was angry; therefore again demoted.
translations.idiomatic: At first Yuxi, Zongyuan, and the other eight offended the multitude's anger. Xianzong also was angry. Therefore they were again demoted.

sentences.zh: 制有「逢恩不原」之令。

translations.literal: The edict had the order 'meeting favor not pardoned.'
translations.idiomatic: The edict had the order "meeting favor not pardoned."

sentences.zh: 然執政惜其才，欲洗滌痕累，漸序用之。

translations.literal: Yet those in power cherished their talent, wishing to wash away traces and gradually order employment.
translations.idiomatic: Yet those in power cherished their talent, wishing to wash away traces and gradually order employment.

sentences.zh: 會程異復掌轉運，有詔以韓臯及禹錫等為遠郡刺史。

translations.literal: It happened Cheng Yi again held transport; there was an edict making Han Gao and Yuxi and others distant prefectural prefects.
translations.idiomatic: It happened Cheng Yi again held transport. There was an edict making Han Gao and Yuxi and others distant prefectural prefects.

sentences.zh: 屬武元衡在中書，諫官十餘人論列，言不可復用而止。

translations.literal: It happened Wu Yuanheng was in the Secretariat; more than ten remonstrance officials argued in array, saying they could not again be employed, and it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: It happened Wu Yuanheng was in the Secretariat. More than ten remonstrance officials argued in array, saying they could not again be employed, and it stopped.

sentences.zh: 禹錫積歲在湘、澧間，郁悒不怡，因讀《張九齡文集》，乃敘其意曰：「世稱曲江為相，建言放臣不宜於善地，多徙五溪不毛之鄉。

translations.literal: Yuxi accumulated years between Xiang and Li, depressed and not pleased; therefore reading Zhang Jiuling's collected works, he then narrated his intent, saying: 'The age praises Qujiang as chancellor; he proposed that exiled ministers ought not be in good lands, mostly transferred to the Five Streams' barren lands.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxi accumulated years between Xiang and Li, depressed and not pleased. Therefore reading Zhang Jiuling's collected works, he then narrated his intent, saying, "The age praises Qujiang as chancellor. He proposed that exiled ministers ought not be in good lands, mostly transferred to the Five Streams' barren lands.

sentences.zh: 今讀其文章，自內職牧始，安有瘴癘之嘆，自退相守荊州，有拘囚之思。

translations.literal: Now reading his literature—from inner office shepherd beginning, how was there sighing at miasma; from retired chancellor guarding Jingzhou, there was thought of imprisoned captive.
translations.idiomatic: Now reading his literature—from inner office shepherd beginning, how was there sighing at miasma; from retired chancellor guarding Jingzhou, there was thought of imprisoned captive.

sentences.zh: 托諷禽鳥，寄辭草樹，郁然與騷人同風。

translations.literal: Entrusting allegory to birds, lodging words in grass and trees, dense like the Sao poets' same wind.
translations.idiomatic: Entrusting allegory to birds, lodging words in grass and trees, dense like the Sao poets' same wind.

sentences.zh: 嗟夫，身出於遐陬，一失意而不能堪，矧華人士族，而必致醜地，然後快意哉！

translations.literal: Alas! Born from remote borderlands, one loss of intent and unable to bear—how much more Chinese gentlemen and clans, yet must reach ugly lands and then be pleased!
translations.idiomatic: Alas! Born from remote borderlands, one loss of intent and unable to bear—how much more Chinese gentlemen and clans, yet must reach ugly lands and then be pleased!

sentences.zh: 議者以曲江為良臣，識胡雛有反相，羞與凡器同列，密啟廷諍，雖古哲人不及。

translations.literal: Discussants take Qujiang as good minister; knowing the Hu chick had rebellious appearance, ashamed to be with common vessels in rank, secretly reporting court remonstrance—though ancient wise men did not reach.
translations.idiomatic: Discussants take Qujiang as good minister, knowing the Hu chick had rebellious appearance, ashamed to be with common vessels in rank, secretly reporting court remonstrance—though ancient wise men did not reach.

sentences.zh: 而燕翼無似，終為餒魂。

translations.literal: Yet swallows' wings had no likeness; in the end became starved souls.
translations.idiomatic: Yet swallows' wings had no likeness; in the end became starved souls.

sentences.zh: 豈忮心失恕，陰謫最大，雖二美莫贖耶？

translations.literal: Could jealous heart lose forgiveness, secretly demoting the greatest, though two beauties not redeem?
translations.idiomatic: Could jealous heart lose forgiveness, secretly demoting the greatest, though two beauties not redeem?

sentences.zh: 不然，何袁公一言明楚獄而鐘祉四葉。

translations.literal: Otherwise, why did Lord Yuan's one word clarify Chu prison and bell blessing four generations?
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, why did Lord Yuan's one word clarify Chu prison and bell blessing four generations?

sentences.zh: 以是相較，神可誣乎？」

translations.literal: Comparing thus, can spirit be deceived?'
translations.idiomatic: Comparing thus, can spirit be deceived?"

sentences.zh: 禹錫晚年與少傅白居易友善，詩筆文章，時無在其右者。

translations.literal: Yuxi in later years was friendly with Junior Mentor Bai Juyi; poetry brush and literature, the time had none to his right.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxi in later years was friendly with Junior Mentor Bai Juyi. In poetry brush and literature, the time had none to his right.

sentences.zh: 常與禹錫唱和往來，因集其詩而序之曰：「彭城劉夢得，詩豪者也。

translations.literal: Often with Yuxi exchanging harmonized verses back and forth, therefore gathering his poetry and prefacing it, saying: 'Pengcheng Liu Mengde is a poetry hero.
translations.idiomatic: Often with Yuxi exchanging harmonized verses back and forth, therefore gathering his poetry and prefacing it, saying, "Pengcheng Liu Mengde is a poetry hero.

sentences.zh: 其鋒森然，少敢當者。

translations.literal: His edge is forest-like; few dare meet him.
translations.idiomatic: His edge is forest-like; few dare meet him.

sentences.zh: 予不量力，往往犯之。

translations.literal: I do not measure strength, often offending him.
translations.idiomatic: I do not measure strength, often offending him.

sentences.zh: 夫合應者聲同，交爭者力敵。

translations.literal: Those who harmonize ought to have same sound; those who contend ought to have matched strength.
translations.idiomatic: Those who harmonize ought to have same sound; those who contend ought to have matched strength.

sentences.zh: 一往一復，欲罷不能。

translations.literal: One going one returning, wishing to stop unable.
translations.idiomatic: One going one returning, wishing to stop unable.

sentences.zh: 由是每制一篇，先於視草，視竟則興作，興作則文成。

translations.literal: From this whenever composing one piece, first at draft viewing; when viewing finished then rising to compose; when rising to compose then literature completed.
translations.idiomatic: From this whenever composing one piece, first at draft viewing. When viewing finished then rising to compose; when rising to compose then literature completed.

sentences.zh: 一二年來，日尋筆硯，同和贈答，不覺滋多。

translations.literal: One-two years coming, daily seeking brush and inkstone, together harmonizing presenting and answering, not aware gradually many.
translations.idiomatic: One-two years coming, daily seeking brush and inkstone, together harmonizing presenting and answering, not aware gradually many.

sentences.zh: 春以前，紙墨所存者，凡一百三十八首。

translations.literal: Before spring, what paper and ink preserved, in all one hundred thirty-eight pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Before spring, what paper and ink preserved, in all one hundred thirty-eight pieces.

sentences.zh: 其餘乘興仗醉，率然口號者，不在此數。

translations.literal: The rest riding impulse relying on wine, casually mouth-calling, not in this count.
translations.idiomatic: The rest riding impulse relying on wine, casually mouth-calling, not in this count.

sentences.zh: 因命小侄龜兒編勒成兩軸。

translations.literal: Therefore ordering young nephew Guier to compile and bind into two scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore ordering young nephew Guier to compile and bind into two scrolls.

sentences.zh: 仍寫二本，一付龜兒，一授夢得小男侖郎，各令收藏，附兩家文集。

translations.literal: Still writing two copies—one given Guier, one given Mengde's young son Lunlang—each ordered to preserve, attached to the two families' collected works.
translations.idiomatic: Still writing two copies—one given Guier, one given Mengde's young son Lunlang—each ordered to preserve, attached to the two families' collected works.

sentences.zh: 予頃與元微之唱和頗多，或在人口。

translations.literal: I recently with Yuan Weizhi harmonized quite many, some in people's mouths.
translations.idiomatic: I recently with Yuan Weizhi harmonized quite many, some in people's mouths.

sentences.zh: 嘗戲微之云：『僕與足下二十年來為文友詩敵，幸也！

translations.literal: Once joking to Weizhi, saying: 'I and you these twenty years as literature friends and poetry foes—fortunate!
translations.idiomatic: Once joking to Weizhi, he said, 'You and I these twenty years have been literary friends and poetic rivals—fortunate!

sentences.zh: 亦不幸也。

translations.literal: Also unfortunate.
translations.idiomatic: Also unfortunate.

sentences.zh: 吟詠情性，播揚名聲，其適遺形，其樂忘老，幸也！

translations.literal: Chanting and singing disposition, spreading and raising fame and sound, its fitting abandoning form, its joy forgetting age—fortunate!
translations.idiomatic: Chanting and singing disposition, spreading and raising fame and sound, its fitting abandoning form, its joy forgetting age—fortunate!

sentences.zh: 然江南士女語才子者，多云元、白，以子之故，使僕不得獨步於吳、越間，此亦不幸也！

translations.literal: Yet Jiangnan gentlemen and ladies speaking of talented sons mostly all say Yuan and Bai; because of you, making me unable to walk alone between Wu and Yue—this also unfortunate!
translations.idiomatic: Yet Jiangnan gentlemen and ladies speaking of talented sons mostly all say Yuan and Bai. Because of you, making me unable to walk alone between Wu and Yue—this also unfortunate!

sentences.zh: 今垂老復遇夢得，非重不幸耶？』

translations.literal: Now aging again meeting Mengde—is this not double unfortunate!'
translations.idiomatic: Now, aging, to meet Mengde again—is this not doubly unfortunate?'

sentences.zh: 夢得夢得，文之神妙，莫先於詩。

translations.literal: Mengde, Mengde—literature's divine marvel, none before poetry.
translations.idiomatic: Mengde, Mengde—literature's divine marvel, none before poetry.

sentences.zh: 若妙與神，則吾豈敢？

translations.literal: If marvelous with spirit, then how dare I!
translations.idiomatic: If marvelous with spirit, then how dare I!

sentences.zh: 如夢得『雪裏高山頭白早，海中仙果子生遲』，『沈舟側畔千帆過，病樹前頭萬木春』之句之類，真謂神妙矣！

translations.literal: Like Mengde's 'in snow high mountain head white early, in sea immortal fruit child born slow,' 'sunk boat beside side thousand sails pass, sick tree before head ten thousand trees spring'—lines of this kind, truly called divine marvel!
translations.idiomatic: Like Mengde's 'High mountains whiten early in the snow; sea-born immortal fruit ripens slow,' and 'Beside the sunken boat a thousand sails go by; before the sick tree ten thousand trees greet spring'—lines of this kind are truly divine!

sentences.zh: 在在處處，應有靈物護持，豈止兩家子弟秘藏而已！」

translations.literal: Everywhere everywhere, ought to have spiritual things protecting and holding—how only the two families' sons and younger brothers secretly treasuring!'
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere everywhere, ought to have spiritual things protecting and holding—how only the two families' sons and younger brothers secretly treasuring!"

sentences.zh: 其為名流許與如此。

translations.literal: He was permitted by famous currents like this.
translations.idiomatic: He was permitted by famous currents like this.

sentences.zh: 夢得嘗為《西塞懷古》、《金陵五題》等詩，江南文士稱為佳作，雖名位不達，公卿大僚多與之交。

translations.literal: Mengde once composed 'Nostalgia at Xisai,' 'Five Pieces on Jinling,' and other poems; Jiangnan literati called them fine pieces; though fame and position did not reach, great ministers and high officials mostly befriended him.
translations.idiomatic: Mengde once composed Nostalgia at Xisai, Five Pieces on Jinling, and other poems. Jiangnan literati called them fine pieces. Though fame and position did not reach, great ministers and high officials mostly befriended him.

sentences.zh: 開成初，復為太子賓客分司，俄授同州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaicheng he again became Junior Mentor deputy commissioner; soon appointed Tongzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaicheng he again became Junior Mentor deputy commissioner. Soon he was appointed Tongzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，檢校禮部尚書、太子賓客分司。

translations.literal: When term was complete, acting Minister of Rites and Junior Mentor deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When term was complete, he was made acting Minister of Rites and Junior Mentor deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七月卒，時年七十一，贈戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he died, aged seventy-one; posthumously made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he died, aged seventy-one. He was posthumously made Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 子承雍，登進士第，亦有才藻。

translations.literal: His son Chengyong passed the jinshi degree; also had literary talent.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chengyong passed the jinshi degree and also had literary talent.

sentences.zh: 柳宗元，字子厚，河東人。

translations.literal: Liu Zongyuan, styled Zihou, was a native of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zongyuan, whose courtesy name was Zihou, was a native of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 後魏侍中濟陰公之系孫。

translations.literal: Descendant of Prince Jiyin of Later Wei, attendant in the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: He was a descendant of Prince Jiyin of Later Wei, attendant in the inner court.

sentences.zh: 曾伯祖奭，高祖朝宰相。

translations.literal: Great-granduncle Shi was Gaozu's court chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: His great-granduncle Shi was Gaozu's court chancellor.

sentences.zh: 父鎮，太常博士，終侍御史。

translations.literal: Father Zhen, Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, ended as Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhen was Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and ended as Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 宗元少聰警絕眾，尤精《西漢詩騷》。

translations.literal: Zongyuan in youth was clever and alert beyond the multitude; he especially mastered Western Han poetry and Sao.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyuan in youth was clever and alert beyond the multitude. He especially mastered Western Han poetry and Sao.

sentences.zh: 下筆構思，與古為侔。

translations.literal: Setting brush and conceiving, he matched antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Setting brush and conceiving, he matched antiquity.

sentences.zh: 精裁密緻，燦若珠貝。

translations.literal: Finely cut and densely woven, brilliant like pearls and shells.
translations.idiomatic: Finely cut and densely woven, brilliant like pearls and shells.

sentences.zh: 當時流輩咸推之。

translations.literal: Contemporaries of the current generation all pushed him.
translations.idiomatic: Contemporaries of the current generation all pushed him.

sentences.zh: 登進士第，應舉宏辭，授校書郎、藍田尉，

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi degree, responded to the macro-elocution examination, was appointed proofreader and Lantian magistrate,
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi degree, responded to the macro-elocution examination, and was appointed proofreader and Lantian magistrate,

sentences.zh: 為監察御史。

translations.literal: became Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: and became Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 順宗即位，王叔文、韋執誼用事，尤奇待宗元。

translations.literal: When Shunzong ascended, Wang Shuwen and Wei Zhiyi held power; especially strangely treated Zongyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Shunzong ascended, Wang Shuwen and Wei Zhiyi held power and especially strangely treated Zongyuan.

sentences.zh: 與監察呂溫密引禁中，與之圖事。

translations.literal: With Supervising Censor Lü Wen he secretly led into the forbidden precinct and with them plotted affairs.
translations.idiomatic: With Supervising Censor Lü Wen he secretly led into the forbidden precinct and with them plotted affairs.

sentences.zh: 轉尚書禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 叔文欲大用之，會居位不久，叔文敗，與同輩七人俱貶。

translations.literal: Shuwen wished greatly to employ him; it happened he was in position not long; Shuwen failed; with the same cohort seven men all were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Shuwen wished greatly to employ him. It happened he was in position not long. Shuwen failed, and with the same cohort seven men all were demoted.

sentences.zh: 宗元為邵州刺史。

translations.literal: Zongyuan was made Shaozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyuan was made Shaozhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 在道，再貶永州司馬。

translations.literal: On the road, again demoted to Yongzhou adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: On the road, he was again demoted to Yongzhou adjutant.

sentences.zh: 既罹竄逐，涉履蠻瘴，崎嶇堙厄，蘊騷人之鬱悼。

translations.literal: Having suffered banishment and expulsion, treading barbarian miasma, rugged blockage and calamity, he harbored the Sao poets' gloomy grief.
translations.idiomatic: Having suffered banishment and expulsion, treading barbarian miasma through rugged blockage and calamity, he harbored the Sao poets' gloomy grief.

sentences.zh: 寫情敘事，動必以文。

translations.literal: Writing feeling and narrating affairs, moving he must use literature.
translations.idiomatic: Writing feeling and narrating affairs, whenever he moved he must use literature.

sentences.zh: 為騷文十數篇，覽之者為之淒惻。

translations.literal: He composed more than ten pieces of Sao literature; viewers were bleak for them.
translations.idiomatic: He composed more than ten pieces of Sao literature. Viewers were bleak for them.

sentences.zh: 柳州土俗，以男女質錢，過期則沒入錢主，宗元革其鄉法。

translations.literal: Liuzhou local custom used men and women as pledge for money; when expired they were confiscated to the money master; Zongyuan abolished that village law.
translations.idiomatic: Liuzhou local custom used men and women as pledge for money. When expired they were confiscated to the money master. Zongyuan abolished that village law.

sentences.zh: 其已沒者，仍出私錢贖之，歸其父母。

translations.literal: Those already confiscated, he still produced private money to redeem them and return them to their parents.
translations.idiomatic: Those already confiscated, he still produced private money to redeem them and return them to their parents.

sentences.zh: 江嶺間為進士者，不遠數千里皆隨宗元師法；

translations.literal: Among the Jiang and Ling ranges those becoming jinshi scholars, not far several thousand li all followed Zongyuan's teacher method;
translations.idiomatic: Among the Jiang and Ling ranges those becoming jinshi scholars, not far several thousand li all followed Zongyuan's teacher method.

sentences.zh: 凡經其門，必為名士。

translations.literal: in all passing his gate, must become famous scholars.
translations.idiomatic: In all passing his gate, they must become famous scholars.

sentences.zh: 著述之盛，名動於時，時號柳州云。

translations.literal: Writings' flourishing, fame moving in the time, the age called him Liuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Writings' flourishing, fame moving in the time, the age called him Liuzhou.

sentences.zh: 有文集四十卷。

translations.literal: He had collected works in forty scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: He had collected works in forty scrolls.

sentences.zh: 韋辭，字踐之。

translations.literal: Han Ci, styled Jianzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Han Ci, whose courtesy name was Jianzhi.

sentences.zh: 祖召卿，洛陽丞。

translations.literal: Grandfather Zhaoging, Luoyang assistant magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zhaoging was Luoyang assistant magistrate.

sentences.zh: 父翃，官至侍御史。

translations.literal: Father Hong, office reached Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: His father Hong, office reached Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 辭少以兩經擢第，判入等，為秘書省校書郎。

translations.literal: Ci in youth with the two classics passed selection, judgment entered rank, became Secretariat proofreader.
translations.idiomatic: Ci in youth with the two classics passed selection, judgment entered rank, and became Secretariat proofreader.

sentences.zh: 貞元末，東都留守韋夏卿辟為從事。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhenyuan eastern capital resident guardian Wei Xiaqing recruited him as staff member.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhenyuan eastern capital resident guardian Wei Xiaqing recruited him as staff member.

sentences.zh: 後累佐使府，皆以參畫稱職，

translations.literal: Later repeatedly assisting envoy staffs, all by planning and drawing called fulfilling duty,
translations.idiomatic: Later repeatedly assisting envoy staffs, all by planning and drawing were called fulfilling duty.

sentences.zh: 自藍田令入拜侍御史，以事累出為朗州刺史，再貶江州司馬。

translations.literal: from Lantian magistrate entering appointment as Attending Censor; because of affairs repeatedly sent out as Langzhou prefect, again demoted Jiangzhou adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: From Lantian magistrate he entered appointment as Attending Censor. Because of affairs he was repeatedly sent out as Langzhou prefect and again demoted to Jiangzhou adjutant.

sentences.zh: 長慶初，韋處厚、路隨以公望居顯要，素知辭有文學理行，亟稱薦之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Changqing Wei Chuhou and Lu Sui with public expectation occupied prominent importance; they always knew Ci had literary learning and principle in conduct; they urgently praised and recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Changqing Wei Chuhou and Lu Sui with public expectation occupied prominent importance. They always knew Ci had literary learning and principle in conduct and urgently praised and recommended him.

sentences.zh: 擢為戶部員外，轉刑部郎中，充京西北和糴使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue, transferred to Director of the Ministry of Justice, filling northwest capital He grain commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue, transferred to Director of the Ministry of Justice, filling northwest capital He grain commissioner.

sentences.zh: 尋為戶部郎中、兼御史中丞，充鹽鐵副使，轉吏部郎中。

translations.literal: Soon Director of the Ministry of Revenue, concurrently Vice Censor-in-Chief, filling salt and iron vice commissioner, transferred to Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Director of the Ministry of Revenue, concurrently Vice Censor-in-Chief, filling salt and iron vice commissioner, he was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 文宗即位，韋處厚執政，且以澄汰浮華、登用藝實為事，乃以辭與李翺同拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: When Wenzong ascended, Wei Chuhou held government; and with clarifying and washing flashy floatation and elevating artistic substance as affairs, therefore with Ci and Li Ao together were appointed Attendants in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Wenzong ascended, Wei Chuhou held government and with clarifying and washing flashy floatation and elevating artistic substance as affairs. Therefore Ci and Li Ao together were appointed Attendants in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辭素無清藻，文筆不過中才，然處事端實，遊官無黨。

translations.literal: Ci originally had no clear ornament; literature brush did not pass middle talent; yet handling affairs upright and solid, wandering office without faction.
translations.idiomatic: Ci originally had no clear ornament. His literature brush did not pass middle talent. Yet handling affairs upright and solid, wandering office without faction.

sentences.zh: 與李翺特相善，俱擅文學高名。

translations.literal: With Li Ao especially mutually good, both excelled in literary learning and high fame.
translations.idiomatic: With Li Ao especially mutually good, both excelled in literary learning and high fame.

sentences.zh: 疏達自用，不事檢操。

translations.literal: Loose and penetrating self-using, not serving restraint in conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Loose and penetrating self-using, not serving restraint in conduct.

sentences.zh: 處厚以激時用，頗不厭公論；

translations.literal: Chuhou with stirring the time's employment, quite not satisfied public discussion;
translations.idiomatic: Chuhou with stirring the time's employment, quite not satisfied public discussion.

sentences.zh: 辭亦倦於潤色，苦求外任。

translations.literal: Ci also wearied of polishing, bitterly seeking outer appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Ci also wearied of polishing and bitterly sought outer appointment.

sentences.zh: 乃出為潭州刺史、御史中丞、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: He was then sent out as Tanzhou prefect, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was then sent out as Tanzhou prefect, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Hunan observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 在鎮二年，吏民稱治。

translations.literal: At command two years, officials and people called it well governed.
translations.idiomatic: At command two years, officials and people called it well governed.

sentences.zh: 卒，時年五十八，贈右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: He died, aged fifty-eight; posthumously made Right Regular Mounted Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He died, aged fifty-eight. He was posthumously made Right Regular Mounted Attendant.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：貞元、太和之間，以文學聳動搢紳之伍者，宗元、禹錫而已。

translations.literal: The historian says: Between Zhenyuan and Taihe, those who with literature stirred the gentry ranks were only Zongyuan and Yuxi.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: Between Zhenyuan and Taihe, those who with literature stirred the gentry ranks were only Zongyuan and Yuxi.

sentences.zh: 其巧麗淵博，屬辭比事，誠一代之宏才。

translations.literal: Their clever ornament and profound breadth, arranging words and comparing affairs, truly one generation's great talent.
translations.idiomatic: Their clever ornament and profound breadth, arranging words and comparing affairs, were truly one generation's great talent.

sentences.zh: 如俾之詠歌帝載，黼藻王言，足以平揖古賢，氣吞時輩。

translations.literal: Like employing them to sing and praise the emperor's records, embroidering and adorning royal words, sufficient to level bow to ancient worthies, spirit swallowing contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: Like employing them to sing and praise the emperor's records and embroider and adorn royal words, they would be sufficient to level bow to ancient worthies and spirit-swallow contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 而蹈道不謹，昵比小人，自致流離，前隳素業。

translations.literal: Yet treading the Way not careful, drawing near and comparing small men, self-causing wandering exile, before destroying plain achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Yet treading the Way not carefully, drawing near and comparing small men, they self-caused wandering exile, before destroying plain achievement.

sentences.zh: 故君子群而不黨，戒懼慎獨，正為此也。

translations.literal: Therefore the gentleman groups yet does not faction, vigilance and fear careful solitude—rightly for this.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the gentleman groups yet does not faction, vigilance and fear in careful solitude—rightly for this.

sentences.zh: 韓、李二文公，於陵遲之末，遑遑仁義；

translations.literal: The two literary lords Han and Li, at the end of decline, urgently pursued benevolence and righteousness;
translations.idiomatic: The two literary lords Han and Li, at the end of decline, urgently pursued benevolence and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 有志於持世範，欲以人文化成，而道未果也。

translations.literal: having intent in upholding the age's model, wishing with human culture to transform and complete, yet the Way was not realized.
translations.idiomatic: Having intent in upholding the age's model, wishing with human culture to transform and complete, yet the Way was not realized.

sentences.zh: 至若抑楊、墨，排釋、老，雖於道未弘，亦端士之用心也。

translations.literal: As for suppressing Yang and Mo, repelling Buddhism and Daoism—though in the Way not broadly spread, also upright gentlemen's intent.
translations.idiomatic: As for suppressing Yang and Mo and repelling Buddhism and Daoism—though in the Way not broadly spread, also upright gentlemen's intent.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：天地經綸，無出斯文。

translations.literal: Eulogy says: Heaven and Earth's weaving, none exits this literature.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy says: Heaven and Earth are woven through order—nothing lies outside this culture.

sentences.zh: 愈、翺揮翰，語切典墳。

translations.literal: Yu and Ao wield brush, words cutting classics and tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu and Li Ao wield the brush; their words cut straight to the classics and tombs.

sentences.zh: 犧雞斷尾，害馬敗群。

translations.literal: Sacrificial cock cutting tail, harmful horse ruining flock.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial cock cuts off its tail; the harmful horse ruins the herd.

sentences.zh: 僻塗自噬，劉、柳諸君。

translations.literal: Crooked path self-devouring, Liu, Liu, and various lords.
translations.idiomatic: On crooked paths they devour themselves—the two Lius and their company.
